spec.prompt: stats.py has a bug: median() returns wrong results for unsorted input. Fix median() in place. Do not change mean().

checks.name: Hidden test: median on unsorted input
checks.code:
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("stats", "stats.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
cases = [([3, 1, 2], 2), ([4, 1, 3, 2], 2.5), ([5], 5), ([9, 7, 8, 1, 2], 7)]
for xs, want in cases:
    got = m.median(list(xs))
    assert got == want, f"median({xs}) = {got}, expected {want}"
print("median ok")
